correctness.rationale: Direct multinomial counting gives the exact probability ratio. F_m strictly concave on x>1, its signs at 2 and m and limit at infinity force exactly two roots when m>=4. Separate m=2,3 cases are algebraic. Uniform Taylor expansion yields the two sharp root formulas and the scaled covariance profile. An independent exhaustive assignment enumerator agrees with exact rational formulas for 20 small (m,n) pairs; exact rational sign scans cover m<=80; no finite scan is treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Singleton boxes are isolated observations in classical allocation/occupancy sampling, studied for normal approximation and variance. The pairwise dependence exhibits an unexpected negative-positive-negative sequence as n increases, confined to a sharp O(sqrt(m)) window around n=m. Its m^-2 critical covariance produces an order-one cross-pair contribution to singleton-count variance, invisible in leading-order CLT approximations; complete sign classification is a natural finite-parameter question, not an arbitrary table slice.
